title: Sum Pair
description: Read two integers and print their sum.
inputFormat: Two space-separated integers a and b.

title: Count Vowels
description: Given a single lowercase string, print the count of vowels (a, e, i, o, u).

title: Second Largest Number
description: Given n integers, print the second largest distinct value.
inputFormat: First line n. Second line contains n integers.

title: Balanced Parentheses
description: Given a string containing only ()[]{} characters, print YES if balanced else NO.

title: Shortest Path in Unweighted Graph
description: Given an undirected unweighted graph, find the shortest distance from source to destination using BFS.
inputFormat: n m on first line. Next m lines: u v. Last line: src dst.

title: Merge Intervals
description: Given n intervals, merge all overlapping intervals and print the resulting intervals in order of start.
inputFormat: First line n. Next n lines contain l r.
outputFormat: Each merged interval in a new line as 'l r'.
